## Deferrals read
Read `docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md` first (rule 1). Dispositions this run:
- **DF-S1.12-3** — the handle-seam wiring lands here: `EnvHandle.containment:
  PolicySlot`, the `attach()` call site storing the `ContainmentReport`,
  `action.environment.attached` referencing `security.containment.applied`,
  seal-side `PermissionUnreachable` warnings via
  `hh_containment::attach()`/`unreachable_permissions()`, and
  `verify_environment`/`verify` per-use revalidation. The live out-of-process
  EP2 helper half stays with S2.1 (unchanged row; note appended).
- All other `OPEN` rows are out of this ticket's scope.

## Progress
- `Cargo.toml` / `crates/hh-env/Cargo.toml` — `hh-env` registered as a workspace
  member; deps `hh-ledger`/`hh-containment`/`hh-monitor`/`hh-secrets`/`hh-hir`/
  `hh-identity`/`hh-provenance`/`hh-ontology`/`hh-wire` (ADR-0249 §1).
- `hh-identity/src/kinds.rs` — `RecordKind::EnvironmentRecord` added (additive,
  semantic projection — CC8).
- `hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` — the `action.environment.*` lifecycle family
  (`provision.requested`/`provisioned`/`ready`/`fenced`/`suspend.*`/`resume.*`/
  `release.*`/`lost`/`probe.*`/`unreachable`/`reattached`/`torn_down`/`snapshot`),
  `action.tool.started`/`completed`/`rejected` rows, and
  `action.effect.unattributed` (the scope-free non-attribution marker);
  `EFFECT_FIELDS` gains `ordinal` + the new payload members the dispatcher
  emits (`baseline_ref`, `attribution_token_hash`, `capture_manifest_ref`, …).
- `hh-ledger/src/effect.rs` — `prepared` on a `reversible` class requires
  `baseline_ref`; `committed` keeps the `Undecided` gate (allow-first);
  `unknown`/`probed` phase support for timeout classification.
- `hh-env` env half — `EnvironmentClass::{LocalHost, LocalSandboxed}` with
  honest `IsolationClass` (`None`/`ProcessSandbox`); `ImageRef` closed sum
  (content address / foreign digest / tag) with `resolve` refusing bare tags
  unless explicitly `unpinned` (foreign digests are recorded claims, never R2
  — `check_repro("R2")` fails them); `EnvironmentRecord`; `EnvHandle` runtime
  object (`declared|ready|unreachable|torn_down`, roots/sessions/health/
  `PolicySlot`/stored `ContainmentReport`/`applied_event_ref`); `EnvMeters`
  three-clock accounting (`reserved ⊇ active + suspended`, kernel-dead gap
  excluded); `EnvDriver` (provision/attach/verify/detach/teardown/heal/fs ops/
  `path_baseline`) appending `action.environment.*` rows; fail-closed `attach`
  (`security.containment.applied`/`unverified` + `attached{applied_ref}` then
  `ready`); seal-side `PermissionUnreachable` warnings (`seal.rs`); heal =
  reattach + probe, never re-execute (ADR-0249).
- `hh-env` exec half — `ToolCapability`; `ExecutorDeclaration`/`bind` refusals
  (`InsufficientDedup`, `InsufficientIsolation`, `InterruptSupport::Unknown`
  reported never coerced); `TokenMinter`/`TokenResolver`/`hash_of`;
  `CaptureItem` + `EffectCaptureManifest::seal` (ephemeral excluded, chunking
  → identity-invariant ref); `ErrorClass` sum + `ErrorOrigin` +
  kernel-derived `retryable` (`retryable_hint` lowers only); deadline/
  interrupt/streaming/dedup; helper-protocol schema (`protocol.rs`) for the
  S2.1 boundary.
- `hh-env` `Dispatcher` — the seven stages `resolve → authorize → prepare →
  commit → execute → capture → observe` over a `ToolExecutor`, minting
  `intended → decided (from Monitor::authorize) → authorized → prepared
  (baseline at prepare for `reversible`) → committed (allow-gated; `read_only`
  skips write-ahead) → started → completed/rejected → observed/refused/
  unknown/unattributed`; tool terminals carry the `tool_call` chain only —
  never `effect_id` (scope already closed in-batch); the dedup-path `rejected`
  anchors at `{turn_id, model_call_id}`; assessor inputs derived honestly —
  `command_parse` `Some` only for `Exec`/`SpawnProcess`,
  `compensator_covered`/`compensation_registered` from the sealed plan id,
  `child_contained` vacuous-yes/`Unknown`; `timeout` maps `read_only →
  observed{not_applied}`, `compensable → unknown → probe` (ADR-0250).
- `hh-env` `LocalExecutor`/`LocalHelperExecutor` — Stage-1 executors; the
  helper executor crosses the spawn boundary the S2.1 binary will own.
- `hh-env` redaction — capture-path masking via `DetectorSet` before manifest/
  blob persistence; non-placeholder hits on executor-reported payloads emit
  `security.secret.leak_detected`; `fs_change` items are kernel-derived
  (driver baseline diff), never executor-reported.
- `crates/hh-env/tests/acceptance.rs` — 13-test AC battery.
